title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Refuelling Fee Line
content:
Equipment returned to Ridgeline Tool Rental with less fuel than it went out with is billed a refuelling fee line on the agreement. This is the agent reference for booking that line.

## Capability

`bill_refuelling_charge_2bf37336` books a single refuelling fee line, dated today, on one returned Ridgeline Tool Rental agreement for equipment returned with less fuel than at checkout, and raises the amount the renter owes on the agreement by exactly the amount billed. The renter sees the refuelling as its own fee line and a higher balance. The tool records the amount passed in; it does not work it out.

## How it is invoked

The tool is agent-side: the Customer Care agent unlocks `bill_refuelling_charge_2bf37336` and then calls it.

## Parameters

1. `rental_agreement_id` — the reference number of the rental agreement (one equipment item) the refuelling is billed on, as returned by the rental agreement lookup.
2. `fuel_amount` — the refuelling charge in USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places and no currency sign; the value is stored by standard rounding to 2 decimal places.

## Return

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| `status` | "billed" when the fee line was booked |
| `rental_charge_id` | the reference of the new fee line |
| `rental_agreement_id` | the agreement it was booked on |
| `fee_type` | always `fuel_charge` |
| `amount` | the charge billed, USD with 2 decimal places |
| `balance_due` | the amount now owed on the agreement, USD with 2 decimal places |

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

`fuel_amount` 96.30 on an agreement owing 40.00 returns `status` "billed", `fee_type` `fuel_charge`, `amount` 96.30 and `balance_due` 136.30.
